'''Eozlin''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who lived in the village of [[Aurilia]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. His main responsibility in the village was to find resources to restore Aurilia's defenses, after it had been attacked by [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Mellichae]] and his [[Sith Shadows]].

==Behind the scenes==
Eozlin appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', but was removed as part the New Game Enhancements of [[2005]], along with Aurilia. ''Star Wars Galaxies'' was shut down on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
